caption: The drawing shows an architectural doorway and a decorative detail of its upper section. The left side depicts a wooden door, partially open, set within a stone or brick structure. The lower part of the wall around the door is colored in light orange and pinkish-red, with a zigzag pattern. Above that is a horizontal decorative band featuring repeated blue, green, and orange motifs. The upper part of the wall consists of rectangular white blocks. The door arch is rounded and outlined with a red border, above which is a series of fans or triangular shapes, colored in alternating red and blue, following the curve of the arch. The right side of the drawing is a close-up detail of the upper corner of the doorway, showing the same decorative elements in profile: the red and blue arch, the scroll at the corner, and the triangular red motifs on top, supported by rectangular white blocks and a red horizontal molding. The floor beneath the doorway is composed of reddish-brown tiles. The entire composition is rendered with watercolor and fine ink lines on a beige background.
title: Restoration Drawing: Wall Decoration Over Doorway, Facade of Mission House
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
